commit.message:
fix(enrollment): close the run-owned authority delta review

Document the required eventstore:stream-scan-native grant and its
separate NativeSourceScan RSA proof in the exact Folders inventory, and
note that persistent manifests with only read grants now refuse. Scope
the preserved leftover record to container and private-material cleanup
failures.

Add a default-run test that runs the C# inventory request bytes through
the launcher's own Python digest and exact-inventory validator, so
producer/launcher drift fails without the Docker lanes.

Record the delta review of the post-review range, the re-verification at
HEAD, and the Folders net11 tooling-fixture fix (Folders cb5de783), and
move story 2.12 to done. The default Platform package build at HEAD
fails outside this story: the tool manifest from 466c6dd1 selects
net10.0; the T lanes were verified with a manifest-property override.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
